description: Submits a business to a town's directory, on the same rails as create_event_listing: screened inside the call, approved paid submissions come back with a hosted payment URL. CHARGES NOTHING — a person must open the URL and enter card details. A paid listing runs for 30 days starting the day payment clears; a free (`standard`) one publishes only if a person approves it. Call get_listing_prices first.

buyerEmail.description: Where the receipt and the payment link go. Must be a real address, not a disposable one. An accepted submission also subscribes this address to the town's daily email (one-click unsubscribe in every issue) — tell the person.

category.description: One of the directory's categories, e.g. "Food & Drink", "Home & Trades".

tier.description: standard = free review queue; listing and featured are paid and return a payment link.

url.description: The business's website or page. Required.

name: create_business_listing
title: List a business in a town (returns a payment link)
